mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms (verapamil via calcium channel blockade, sacubitril via neprilysin inhibition), resulting in additive hypotensive and negative inotropic effects with increased risk of bradycardia and heart block.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac function closely; consider dose reduction of verapamil or alternative AV nodal blocking agent; avoid combination if possible, particularly in patients with baseline conduction abnormalities.
